say:1:1130506001:1.text: In regard to the Quicksand Claws, the local gang of these parts.
say:1:1130506001:1.source_cn: 流沙之爪，这里强盗团伙的名字。
say:1:1130506001:1.male: In regard to the Quicksand Claws, the local gang of these parts.
say:1:1130506001:1.female: In regard to the Quicksand Claws, the local gang of these parts.

say:2:1130506002:1.text: Their numbers weren't too many a few years back. More akin to thieving rats than a gang.
say:2:1130506002:1.source_cn: 几年前没几个人，像老鼠一样钻来钻去。
say:2:1130506002:1.male: Their numbers weren't too many a few years back. More akin to thieving rats than a gang.
say:2:1130506002:1.female: Their numbers weren't too many a few years back. More akin to thieving rats than a gang.

say:3:1130506003:1.text: Once the legend of the hidden treasure sprang from the Crimson Highlands, they multiplied like rabbits. They've even taken captives from neighboring settlements!
say:3:1130506003:1.source_cn: 深红高原传出宝藏传说后，他们开始迅速扩张，掳走了不少周...
say:3:1130506003:1.male: Once the legend of the hidden treasure sprang from the Crimson Highlands, they multiplied like rabbits. They've even taken captives from neighboring settlements!
say:3:1130506003:1.female: Once the legend of the hidden treasure sprang from the Crimson Highlands, they multiplied like rabbits. They've even taken captives from neighboring settlements!

say:4:1130506004:1.text: Those they've taken haven't been heard from since, and no one's sure if they're alive or dead...
say:4:1130506004:1.source_cn: 那些被抓走的人后来都没了消息，也不知道是生是死……
say:4:1130506004:1.male: Those they've taken haven't been heard from since, and no one's sure if they're alive or dead...
say:4:1130506004:1.female: Those they've taken haven't been heard from since, and no one's sure if they're alive or dead...

say:5:1130506005:1.text: I just hope they're somehow alright.
say:5:1130506005:1.source_cn: 希望被抓走的那些人都能没事。
say:5:1130506005:1.male: I just hope they're somehow alright.
say:5:1130506005:1.female: I just hope they're somehow alright.
